source.citation: Iwasaki S, Zhu A, Hanley M, et al. A translational physiologically based pharmacokinetics/pharmacodynamics framework of target-mediated disposition, target inhibition and drug-drug interactions of bortezomib. AAPS J. 2020;22:66. doi:10.1208/s12248-020-00448-x
source.article_status: Subscription article; the platform has not read the full text. The abstract states the model was built bottom-up from preclinical data and human physiological parameters. Which human studies were used to evaluate it is not yet confirmed.

compartments.Crbc: systemic red blood cells (Vrbc); drug present only as bound to 20S proteasome
compartments.Chrbc: hepatic red blood cells (Vhrbc); bound drug only

structure.concentration_unit: ng/mL (inferred: C/MW x 1000 is used as nM against Bmax in nM; stated nowhere explicitly)
structure.volumes_and_flows: Per kg body weight (Table 2 units L/kg and L/h/kg).
structure.elimination: Hepatic metabolism of unbound liver drug only: fu,liver x (sum of fm) x CLint x Ch (equation 6). No renal or other clearance.
structure.target_binding: Second-order binding of unbound plasma drug (fu,p x C) to free proteasome sites (Bmax x V - bound) in systemic and hepatic RBC, first-order dissociation. No proteasome turnover and no RBC turnover in the equations.
not_in_communication: Dose input (route, compartment, bolus or infusion).
The pharmacodynamic equation for blood proteasome inhibition.
Conversion from a dose in mg/m2 to the per-kg model (body weight and body surface area).

equations.text: Vsys*dCp/dt = -Qh*(1-Hct)*Cp + Qh*(1-Hct)*Chp - CLperi*Cp + CLperi*Cperi - Kon*(Bmax*Vrbc - Vrbc*Crbc/MW*1000)*fu,p*Cp + Koff*Vrbc*Crbc
Vhp*dChp/dt = Qh*(1-Hct)*Cp - Qh*(1-Hct)*Chp - PSliv*fu,p*Chp + PSliv*fu,liver*Ch - Kon*(Bmax*Vhrbc - Vhrbc*Chrbc/MW*1000)*fu,p*Chp + Koff*Vhrbc*Chrbc
Vhrbc*dChrbc/dt = Qh*Hct*Crbc - Qh*Hct*Chrbc + Kon*(Bmax*Vhrbc - Vhrbc*Chrbc/MW*1000)*fu,p*Chp - Koff*Vhrbc*Chrbc
Vh*dCh/dt = PSliv*fu,p*Chp - PSliv*fu,liver*Ch - fu,liver*(fm,1A2 + fm,2C9 + fm,2C19 + fm,2D6 + fm,3A4)*CLint*Ch

table_notes.a: Calculated based on total liver volume (17), vascular fraction (16) and hematocrit.
table_notes.c: Scaled from monkey by simple allometry.
table_notes.e: Estimated from fu,p and liver-to-plasma concentration ratio in monkeys.
table_notes.f: Estimated from metabolic clearance in human liver microsomes.
table_notes.g: Estimated based on the inhibitory effect of P450-specific inhibitory monoclonal antibodies on bortezomib metabolism in human liver microsomes.
table_notes.h: Assumed rapid equilibrium between hepatic plasma and liver compartments.

observations_on_transcription: Vsys (0.418 L/kg, scaled from monkey) is about ten times physiological plasma volume (about 0.04 L/kg); it acts as an apparent central volume, so the model is partly empirical.
The fm values sum to 0.999, so total metabolic clearance of unbound liver drug is 0.999 x CLint.
Vhp / (Vhp + Vhrbc) = 0.561 = 1 - Hct (0.44), consistent with note a.
RBC binding capacity Bmax x Vrbc = 27.9 nmol/kg (10.7 ug/kg).
not_this: A transcription of a published research model for checking against independent data. Not validated for any patient; no output of this model is shown on the platform until a locked check is run and reported.
